description: SWE-ContextBench Lite prior-experience retrieval comparison with no-memory, lexical-overlap, and governed Agent Memory arms. Protocol-comparable external evidence is blocked on the exact redacted past-task projections and batch/distractor selection provenance.

source_rights.attribution: SWE-ContextBench (upstream repository jiayuanz3/SWEContextBench); the harness owns only the gold-edge/ranking comparison
source_rights.acquisition_notes: The committed manifests are synthetic or historical projections. The exact redacted past-task projections and batch/distractor selection provenance required for protocol-comparable evidence have not been obtained (#467).

selection.identity_rule: manifest defines the cases; the harness hashes the manifest, runtime configuration, evidence profile, and every experience/query sidecar file (inputs.file_sha256)

native_metrics.description: gold edges among governed admitted results

native_artifacts.description: backends{no_memory, lexical_overlap, agent_memory}, comparison deltas, comparability, claim_boundary

budget.retrieval_or_context_budget: lexical top-k 3 with anchor limit 3; consistency repeat count 5

failure_semantics.description: any exception aborts the run; ValueError becomes a CLI error; missing manifest files fail closed

system_requirements.unsupported_semantics: the Agent Memory arm binds internal runtime classes (ConfiguredCompositionRuntime, query_driven_recall); no external system can enter this runner without a new system-neutral runner

unmapped_dimensions.retrieval: blocked: no protocol-comparable frozen external input exists (#467); the harness report is not normalized until it does
unmapped_dimensions.currentness: not_applicable: no update or conflict protocol
unmapped_dimensions.governance: blocked: governed admission counts exist natively but are not normalized while external evidence is blocked
unmapped_dimensions.efficiency: blocked: not normalized while external evidence is blocked
unmapped_dimensions.evaluator_integrity: not_measured: evaluator-integrity mutation probes run separately (reference/run_benchmark_integrity_mutants.py, #518) and are not bound to a run
unmapped_dimensions.reproducibility: blocked: per-file digests exist natively but are not normalized while external evidence is blocked

negative_controls.description: gold removed; recall must fall with denominator unchanged
all candidates refused; admitted recall must fall
ranks inverted; nDCG@1 must fall with recall equal
gold refused; false refusal count must rise

environment_requirements: AGENT_MEMORY_REVISION or a git checkout for revision binding
artifact_requirements: harness report JSON with inputs.file_sha256 for every input file

gauntlet.reason: the runner binds Agent Memory internal runtime classes and a manifest-bound projection; it cannot host a system-neutral profile and its external evidence is blocked

evidence_history.blocker: exact redacted past-task projections and batch/distractor selection provenance (#467)

limitations: committed manifests are synthetic or historical projections, never protocol-comparable external evidence
the Agent Memory arm uses internal runtime classes rather than the public facade
